3 · Spatial viz ≠ software fluency

IHU teaches 3D in year three alongside 2D — after patternmaking — not as tool fluency alone.

Course geometric background · threshold · #c378606cc29b · Original course SVG

  • Cite: Papahristou and Zolota Tatsi 2024, 270 (IHU); 268 (AMFI).
  • Gap: same review reports tool adoption, not form-understanding instruments (p. 1).
  • Nail: 2D→3D diagnostic + view-change explanation — not render polish.

Digital Creativity I · I.5 Three-Dimensional Form

Recall check

Alone, from memory, 3 minutes. Then compare with a partner.

  1. At IHU, when is 3D prototyping taught relative to 2D?
  2. Name the five I.5 masterclass moves in order.
  3. What does I.5 hand off to I.6?
  4. Papahristou proves validated volume understanding — true/false?
  5. 3D prototyping: replace physical making or teach alongside?

Course geometric background · practice · #1ab1247ed3af · Original course SVG

Timer: 3 minutes alone; 2 minutes pairs. Practice only — not graded.

Answers:

  • 1. Third year, alongside 2D CAD, after traditional patternmaking (Papahristou 2024, 270).
  • 2. Flat vs volumetric · multi-view · spatial viz ≠ software · light/silhouette · I.6 hand-off.
  • 3. Behaviour / fit / drape / discrepancy — not prettier mesh.
  • 4. False — tool adoption, not form-understanding instruments (Papahristou 2024, 1).
  • 5. Alongside — sequenced with 2D/physical literacy.

Digital Creativity I · I.5 Three-Dimensional Form

Exercise 1 · Flat → elevation → volume strip

Sketch flat → side elevation → simple volume for one garment region. Mark one ambiguity only 3D can resolve.

Three-sketch strip + one sentence naming the 3D test you will run next (no CLO required).

Image: Historical costume plate with multiple figures for comparing projections

Costumes civils HISTORICAL CLOTHING OF FRANCE civilian costumes male female dress fashion design c 1640-1925 Public domain French illustration Larousse du XXème siècle 1932 · 19th-century French costume plate engraver · CC0 1.0 · Source

  • Timer: 20 minutes. Individual.
  • Keep the three sketches as one strip.

Source: sequenced 2D→3D structure (Papahristou and Zolota Tatsi 2024, 268, 270).

Digital Creativity I · I.5 Three-Dimensional Form

Exercise 2 · Silhouette from volume (not from polish)

Block the garment as 2–4 volumes, shade only mass, then trace the outer silhouette — compare to a flat of the same design.

Volume block + silhouette trace + flat comparison + one sentence on what the render would have hidden.

Image: Hand drawing on a graphic tablet after a paper sketch

Hand drawing on a graphic tablet · Photograph uploader on Commons · CC BY-SA 4.0 · Source

  • Timer: 20 minutes. Individual.
  • Declared gap: light-on-form RCT in fashion HE.

Ask: If the render looked “correct,” would your silhouette still match the flat?
